findings.appearance: Cloudy ivory stone-like chest with brass fittings, turquoise inset and seam, five angular pale karst islands with green summits and squat pale feet. Closed views retain all five formations; open views show a pale empty interior and underside edged by teal trim.
findings.reference_comparison: Five-island arrangement, ivory/turquoise/green palette, marble-like body and hardware are recognizable matches. Reference inset has more reflective depth; runtime water appears flatter and opaque. Angular green caps and squat irregular feet are already source characteristics.
artistic_gaps: Water reads as a flat colored panel; green summits look like caps rather than vegetation, also present in the reference.
Cloudy stone shading and stepped corner junctions reduce material refinement.
Mobile title isolates 'Karst' on its second line without clipping.
mechanism_concerns_unconfirmed: Open hinge-to-lid clearance and interrupted teal rim strips make attachment visually unclear, without proving missing geometry.
Closed teal seam and layered clasp edges warrant angle/animation inspection only if closure behavior is in scope.

per_frame.desktop_closed: All five island forms and complete chest fit; opaque turquoise surface and chunky corner joints.
per_frame.desktop_open: Empty pale interior and plain underside; open lid hides its exterior landscape normally.
per_frame.mobile_closed: Five islands remain legible; no cropping, minor jagged seams and overlapping-looking latch pieces.
per_frame.mobile_open: Full lid and controls visible; small hinge contacts and dark clearance weaken connection reading.
per_frame.marketing: Ivory marble-like chest with reflective turquoise inset, five green-capped formations and satin brass.

findings.recommendation_reason: Strong motif and palette correspondence, with water/material simplification and unverified hinge behavior. Not final approval.
